question: What's new on Raymond James in the last 90 days?

cells.label: fact

items.text: Raymond James will add $18.7 billion and 70 advisors to its Financial Institutions Division as an existing FID program merges with Synovus Financial Corp., expanding Pinnacle Financial Partners' relationship with Raymond James.
items.quote: Raymond James will add $18.7 billion and 70 advisors to its Financial Institutions Division, the unit dedicated to bank and credit union advisors, as an existing FID program merges with Synovus Financial Corp.

items.text: Raymond James will add 70 advisors to its Financial Institutions Division via the Synovus Financial Corp. merger.
items.quote: Raymond James will add $18.7 billion and 70 advisors to its Financial Institutions Division

items.text: Raymond James launched Private Wealth Guided Portfolios, a risk-based model framework combining equity and fixed income allocations with a dedicated alternatives sleeve covering private markets and hedged strategies.
items.quote: the firm announced the launch of Private Wealth Guided Portfolios, a risk-based model framework that combines equity and fixed income allocations with a dedicated alternatives sleeve covering private markets and hedged strategies

items.text: Raymond James launched a firm-wide SIMPLE IRA Employer Advisory and Consulting Services (SIACS) Program for small businesses with up to 100 employees, in partnership with Capital Group American Funds.
items.quote: has launched a firm-wide SIMPLE IRA Employer Advisory and Consulting Services Program, according to the filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission. The firm has partnered with Capital Group American Funds for the program

items.text: Raymond James agreed to acquire Clark Capital Management Group, a Philadelphia-based asset manager with more than $46 billion under management; the transaction closed in May 2026.
items.quote: the firm agreed to acquire Clark Capital Management Group, a Philadelphia-based asset manager with more than $46 billion under management... That transaction closed in May 2026

items.text: Raymond James made its small-business retirement plan available to its roughly 8,900 advisors.
items.quote: Raymond James has made its small-business retirement plan available to its roughly 8,900 advisors
